verdict.rationale: Galileo documents configurable alert rules on logged data. Each rule takes a metric, an aggregation function, a threshold and a time window, and fires automatically when cost spikes or hallucinations rise. That is a genuine first-party rule-triggers-action capability, but the only action evidenced is being alerted. missing for 10: action types beyond notifications (e.g., automated remediation, workflow or webhook triggers), event types beyond metric thresholds, alert delivery channel details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
